say:2:1320407001:0.text: Hugin! Are you free? We need your help with something.
say:2:1320407001:0.source_cn: 呼金，你最近有空吗？我们想拜托你制造一样物品~

say:3:1320407002:0.text: Oh, what timing! I was just about to ask if you had any ideas for me.
say:3:1320407002:0.source_cn: 嚯，还有这么巧的事！我正打算问问你们有什么好想法呢！

say:4:1320407003:1.text: My brain's been frozen solid since Haldor had me carving ice sculptures. I can't think of anything fresh and exciting to make next, and it's driving me crazy.
say:4:1320407003:1.source_cn: 自打被老约恩抓去雕刻冰雕后，总感觉我的脑子好像被冻僵了...

say:6:1320407004:0.source_cn: 由我来说吧，这样更清楚。

say:7:1320407005:0.text: You see, I've been dreaming of opening up some wild hot springs, but finding them... well, that's been a real puzzle. That's where you come in—I'm hoping you could whip up a little device to help detect them.
say:7:1320407005:0.source_cn: 我们白熊温泉旅店想开辟一些野温泉，但没办法很快确定它们...

say:8:1320407006:0.text: Hm... a detection machine's not hard to make, but the tricky part is figuring out how to tell if there's a hot spring nearby.
say:8:1320407006:0.source_cn: 让我想想……探测机器不难做，难的是通过什么来确定周围有...

say:9:1320407007:0.source_cn: 要是没有能量化的数据，这事就做不成。

say:11:1320407009:0.text: How about using temperature? If you could pick up any significant warmth beneath the ground, we might just be able to find those springs.
say:11:1320407009:0.source_cn: 如果以温差作为标准，探测这片地区哪里温差比较大呢？有温...

say:15:1320407011:0.text: Wow, Madam Gerda's got more than just business sense, those are some technical ideas!
say:15:1320407011:0.source_cn: 哇！格尔达女士看着像是直爽的行动派，没想到居然这么有想法！

say:16:1320407012:0.text: Running an inn like this isn't as simple as it looks, sweetheart.
say:16:1320407012:0.source_cn: 亲爱的，经营一家旅馆可不像听上去那么容易哦。

say:17:1320407013:0.text: If I wasn't using my head, the Frozen Paw wouldn't be where it is today, let alone expanding the way we are.
say:17:1320407013:0.source_cn: 如果我不肯动脑子，白熊温泉旅店也不可能有今天，更别提扩...

say:19:1320407015:0.text: Yes, the hot springs are packed. If we don't find new ones, there won't be space for anyone!
say:19:1320407015:0.source_cn: 是啊，现在旅店的温泉里都是人！要是再没有新温泉的话，恐...

say:20:1320407016:0.text: In that case, I won't just take payment for the device. I'll need a cut of the hot spring profits too!
say:20:1320407016:0.source_cn: 既然这样，你们要的这样工具可不能付钱了事。得让我入伙分...

choice_prompt:21:1320407016.text: In that case, I won't just take payment for the device. I'll need a cut of the hot spring profits too!
choice_prompt:21:1320407016.source_cn: 既然这样，你们要的这样工具可不能付钱了事。得让我入伙分成才行！

say:22:1320407019:0.text: ... I understand that making something new isn't easy, but surely we can work out something, right?
say:22:1320407019:0.source_cn: 矮人兄弟，我知道工匠造新东西不容易，但价格好商量嘛。

say:23:1320407020:0.text: Why don't you just toss me a number, hmm? Let's get this settled nice and quick.
say:23:1320407020:0.source_cn: 不如你说个数，我也痛快一点，咱们直接敲定下来，怎么样？

say:24:1320407021:0.text: No, that won't do. Sure, I'm a craftsman, but I know a good investment when I see one! I'm not letting this opportunity slip by.
say:24:1320407021:0.source_cn: ——不行。我虽然是个工匠，但一向很有投资眼光！想让我看...

say:25:1320407022:0.text: Madam, I'm making a sincere offer here! Having a craftsman like me on your team would be a huge boost for your inn! Think it over, I'll be waiting for your answer!
say:25:1320407022:0.source_cn: 熊妹子，我可是很有诚意的！多一位工匠的帮忙，对你们旅店...

say:27:1320407017:0.text: Whistler, Hardhead, and Shorty all want the same deal!
say:27:1320407017:0.source_cn: 哪里过分？尖哨、铁头和矮地都想这么做！
say:27:1320407017:0.male: Whistler, Hardhead, and Shorty all want the same deal!
say:27:1320407017:0.female: Whistler, Hardhead, and Shorty all want the same deal!

say:28:1320407018:1.text: No no no, not you, her! The owner of the hot springs inn!
say:28:1320407018:1.source_cn: 不不不，不是收你们的钱，是向她们——温泉旅店收钱！
say:28:1320407018:1.male: No no no, not you, her! The owner of the hot springs inn!
say:28:1320407018:1.female: No no no, not you, her! The owner of the hot springs inn!

choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 你原本还打算收我们的钱？
